'''Ralos-Vok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stims]] in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
